# fct_site_page_views

`data-warehouse-359101.analytics.fct_site_page_views` · dbt area: `growth`

Fact table of foratravel.com page views reconstructed from GA4's multi-event structure. Each row is a unique page view with engagement time, page path hierarchy (4 levels), previous/following page paths and event flags. NOTE Google does not track 100% of sessions -- users can opt out of analytics tracking. Sourced from Google Analytics.

| Column | Description |
|---|---|
| `page_view_key` | Unique key assigned to each page view using the user_pseudo_id, session_id, and block_id. Can be null when there is no user_pseudo_id (for example if they block tracking). >> SOURCE - Calculated from Google Analytics data_tests: - unique |
| `page_view_at` | Timestamp of when the page view happened. Used to partition the table. Filter on this column to optimize query cost and performance. >> SOURCE - Google Analytics |
| `campaign` | Used for Attribution. The Campaign associated with UTM when the Session began. >> SOURCE - Google Analytics |
| `channel_grouping` | Groups the Attribution fields into a Channel (such as 'Paid Social') using logic defined by Google here https://support.google.com/analytics/answer/9756891 >> SOURCE - Google Analytics |
| `content` | Used for Attribution. The Content associated with UTM when the Session began. >> SOURCE - Google Analytics |
